LEFT moved the player from cols 44-46 to cols 38-40 (6 cols to the left). board_changed=True, but this is probably just the player moving (need to verify the board didn't re-roll — the image shows the same layout: 3 green blocks at the top, 3x3 on the left, 3 at the bottom, player now at cols ~38-40). OK, so LEFT just moves the player. The board did not re-roll.
So re-rolling happens when: (a) the player enters cols 43-47 (the portal/gap), or (b) on MOUSE. Hmm, wait, actually let me reconsider (b): the MOUSE at row 31, col 45 — col 45 is within the portal cols 43-47! Maybe MOUSE moves the player to the clicked column (or the player to the clicked position), and the re-roll was triggered because the player entered the portal column, not by MOUSE itself!
Let me verify: before MOUSE, the player was at cols 44-46. I clicked (31, 45) — same column. After MOUSE, the player is still at cols 44-46. So MOUSE didn't visibly move the player… but the board re-rolled. Hmm.
Or maybe MOUSE = "dig" or "collect" at the clicked position? The click at (31,45) was on a green block (in the layout at step 8, the green row was at rows 29-33, cols 35-50). After the click, the board re-rolled and the score stayed at 0. So the click didn't collect the green (score 0).
Hmm, wait. Maybe the re-roll at step 9 was triggered because the player was standing in the portal (cols 43-47), and any action while in the portal re-rolls the room. Let me test this hypothesis: currently the player is at cols 38-40 (outside the portal). Do a MOUSE click somewhere (e.g., on the top green block at row 7, col 36). If the board re-rolls → MOUSE always re-rolls (or the click was on the portal). If the board doesn't re-roll → the re-roll at step 9 was portal-related, and MOUSE does something else (maybe collect/dig).
Actually, a better test: click a green block outside the portal column. Top green row: rows 5-9, cols 27-45 (3 blocks: cols 27-33, 34-40, 41-45?). From the col 40 profile: rows 6-10 are N? "BSSSSSSSSSSSBNNNNNB..." col 40: B (0), S (1-11), B (12), N (13-17), B (18), S (19-29), B (30), G (31), B (32), S (33-47), B (48), N (49-53), B (54), S (55-62), W. So col 40 has green at rows 13-17 (top block) and rows 49-53 (bottom block). Click (15, 40) — on the top green block, col 40 is outside the portal (43-47).
